_about: Datasheet pinout records (F-S0-0001). Read by part_pinouts.lookup when KiCad names no symbol for a part. Matched on the whole orderable part number AND the package, never a similar name. Each record cites the page of its pin table; an optional kicad_symbol must agree pin for pin and on package or the part is refused. Written by an agent, these are evidence (T2 source), not a person's verification. 2N2222A is refused: in TO-92 it is not one orderable part (makers differ, E-B-C vs C-B-E); the netlist must carry the orderable number.

records.identity: DHT22 is Aosong's earlier name for the AM2302 (their 2013 manual is titled 'AM2302/DHT22'); the V1.0 manual prints only AM2302. The project already reads DHT22 figures from this document (data/figures.py _DHT, D7 document aosong-am2302-v1.0, same SHA-256). A name identity the maker states, not a similar-name match.
records.alias_note: Table 4 names pin 2 SDA; section 3.2 describes it as the single-bus data line. The netlists call it DATA.
records.checks: Agrees with an independent reference board read by S2 (VDD, DATA, GND on pins 1, 2, 4).
records.recorded_by: S4 agent, 2026-10-22, read from the rendered page 4. Evidence, not a person's verification.
